title: A Study Evaluating the Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Activity of GDC-7035 as a Single Agent and in Combination with other Anti-Cancer Therapies in Patients with Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors with a KRAS G12D Mutation
official: A Phase I/II Dose-Escalation and Expansion Study Evaluating the Safety, Pharmacokinetics, and Activity of GDC-7035 as a Single Agent and in Combination with Other Anti-Cancer Therapies in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors With a KRAS G12D Mutation
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the safety of GDC-7035 as a single agent and in combination with other anti-cancer therapies
conditions: Advanced or metastatic solid tumors with KRAS G12D mutation
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histologically documented advanced or metastatic solid tumor with KRAS G12D mutation
2. Age ≥ 18 years
3. Agreement to adhere to the contraception requirements described in the protocol for participants of childbearing potential and participants who produce sperm
Exclusion criteria:
1. Malabsorption or other condition that would interfere with enteral absorption
2. Active brain metastases
3. Clinically significant cardiovascular dysfunction or liver disease
